description: The Chinese A-share market's LIMIT-DOWN board (跌停板) for a trading day — how many stocks hit their daily DOWN price limit (-10%, or -20% for STAR/ChiNext) and the ranked list of those stocks. Answers 'how many A-shares hit limit down today', '跌停家数', 'which stocks 跌停', 'limit-down stock count for a China A-share trading day' — the counterpart to ashares_limit_up, together giving market-wide limit-up/limit-down breadth. Each stock includes code, name, price, change % (negative), turnover (成交额), float market cap, turnover rate (换手率), seal fund (封板资金), last seal time, industry (行业), and P/E. Source: Eastmoney (keyless).

date.description: Trading day as YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD (default: most recent trading day).

limit.description: How many stocks to return, 1–100 (default 30). The total count is always returned regardless.

name: ashares_limit_down
